correctness.rationale: Directly differentiate the Theis response to get the positive-kernel-weighted sign \(\Phi_	au-\lambda\); its logarithmic derivative is a quadratic with exactly zero or one positive-time turning time. The rate threshold and complete strict-extrema counts follow. The smooth-minimum envelope derivative and evaluation at \(	au+b\) establish unique global peak \(b/a\) at \(	au=a-b\) for \(a>b\), with zero endpoint limits. Exact inequalities certify the reentrant \(2,0,2\) example; 4,500 randomized samples and 100 direct differential checks supplement rather than prove the quantified theorem.
